name: Parts Wash

features.text: Contains no fluorocarbons to adversely affect the ozone layer.
Contains no chlorinated solvents to contaminate waste oil, resulting in high cost of disposal.
Will not rust metal surfaces like some water- based cleaners.
Helps reduce labor costs and save time.

description: A solvent cleaner designed to remove grease, grime, oil and other debris from fabricated parts. It dries quickly and leaves no residue. Warning: Flammable.
application: Cover all rubber and painted surfaces. Do not spray on, or allow to drip on hot surfaces. Hold can in the upright position 6 to 8 inches from the surface to be cleaned. Spray generously to ensure a complete cleaning. Allow liquid to run off and allow to air dry.
